about_the_game:
Embark on a journey to medieval Poland in the year 1410 in the free demo of Kingdom of Poland: 1410. Step into the shoes of Jan, an experienced hunter and tracker who arrives in the village of Nieszawa, where locals mysteriously disappear. Your task will be to uncover the truth, face the dangers of the forest, and fight for survival in the brutal world of the 15th century.

Jan set out from Brest a few months earlier when his village was struck by famine and bandit raids.

He lived off hunting and trading furs but recently has been earning his living as a guide and hired tracker.

While wandering, he arrived in Nieszawa, a small village by the river that needs help with the disappearance of people in the surrounding forests.

The demo offers a separate, self-contained story with a new hero, prepared especially to showcase a part of the mechanics of the full version of the game. Awaiting you:

  • Open environment with a village, forests, ruins, and a bandit camp.

  • Exploration and tracking in the wilderness.

  • Combat and survival in the realities of medieval Poland.

  • Dialogues and everyday village life that reacts to your actions.

This is just a taste of the full game, where the story and world will be even larger and more elaborate.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 / AMD FX-Series FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 2 GB / AMD Radeon RX-460 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Free demo of Kingdom of Poland: 1410, set in medieval Poland. Step into the shoes of Jan – an experienced hunter and tracker. Uncover the mystery of the missing people in the forests around the village of Nieszawa. Exploration, combat, tracking, and survival in the 15th century setting.
